Game Overview

Sky Ascension Run puts players into a casual experience centered on dash through the skies in this exhilarating vertical runner. Leap between floating platforms, dodge lethal traps, and climb higher as the speed and stakes increase. Hone your reflexes and try to outpace your last attempt. How high can you go before gravity claims you?
